annotation.authors_or_issuer: ITU/WHO/WIPO Global Initiative on AI for Health (GI-AI4H)
key_provisions_or_claims: Regulatory Working Group to produce a draft Template Law for AI in health by June 2025, drawing on over 60 jurisdictions.
Five-dimensional framework for comparing national AI regulations is being piloted.
Data WG advancing Croissant format and a Data and Model Exchange Protocol for health datasets.
Working groups on data, evaluation, intellectual property, regulation and ethics, plus topic groups.
Emphasis on responsible, equitable AI deployment, especially in low- and middle-income countries.
annotation.summary_en: Meeting report of the second convening of the ITU/WHO/WIPO Global Initiative on AI for Health (Singapore, 17–19 March 2025). It covers working groups on data, evaluation, intellectual property, regulation and ethics, and topic groups. Key commitments include a draft Template Law for AI in health and a health data exchange protocol.
